This '''[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Nanny droid/Legends|Nanny droid]]''' worked in [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] [[Darth Sidious's secret facility/Legends|base]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. She was destroyed along with the station and [[RO-Z67/Legends|RO-Z67]] when Sidious ordered the station's gravity supports to be deactivated, allowing the base to sink into the lava below.
